caveats: OHECC-INSPIRED: original vector is a 27-atom zero-padded flatten of DFT (B3LYP/6-31G**) geometry; ours uses ETKDGv3+MMFF94s and pads to 60 atoms to fit our larger molecules.
Zhou 2025 evaluated DFT optical rotations of QM9 molecules; numbers are not comparable across datasets.
interpretation: OHECC is an order-dependent serialisation of a 3D geometry; on our data the result swings between AUC 0.58 and 0.63 depending solely on atom ordering, so the fair reading is 'AUC ~0.63 best case'. Its original setting was DFT geometries of QM9-scale molecules (<=9 heavy atoms); our molecules are larger (padding 60 atoms vs 27) and use ETKDG/MMFF geometries, so this reimplementation is a lower bound on what the original representation achieves, not a replication.
